BiblicalUsage: thanásimos is the Bible's word for deadly. In Mark 16:18, if they drink any deadly thing. In the Greek text the word is spelled θανάσιμον.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that deadly things are real, but the promise stands that those who belong to Christ are kept.
